title: Two forms of the product-column sum
statement: For bit strings $a,b$ and every natural number $j$, summing the products of their bits over pairs of positions $p<|a|$ and $q<|b|$ with $p+q=j$ gives the product-column value at position $j$; missing bits are interpreted as zero.
